author: Madan Chaolla Park and contributors
description: A safe-by-default Koii task that records and audits one live Post-ID/target-author attestation per round through the official X API. Public proofs contain only Post IDs, User IDs, and Koii task metadata; they do not claim novelty, freshness, or timeline completeness, and posting is disabled.
migrationDescription: 3.0 safe observer-mode redesign; browser posting removed from the production profile.

requirementsTags.description: A read-only X API bearer token. Do not configure user credentials or browser sessions.
